Location: Ankara, Turkey Remote: Yes Willing to relocate: No Technologies: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, PyTorch, LLM integrations, automation, Android apps, Turkish localization Résumé/CV: https://asim.anka.istanbul Email: asim@anka.istanbul

Freelance developer looking for contract or part-time work. I build and ship small products, and I use AI tools heavily to move faster.

Efsun, an AI-powered app on Google Play with 5,000+ downloads. Nirengi, clinic software for psychologists. Anka Connect, an end-to-end encrypted remote desktop. Mira, real-time voice chat with a 3D avatar. Hypatia, an open-source symbolic compiler for PyTorch.

Happy to start with one small, clearly defined task. Previously a Canias ERP project manager. Turkish native, English fluent.
